sloka: दीयते द्वन्द्वयुद्धं ते राक्षसाधिपते मया ।सन्तिष्ठ क्षिप्रमायत्तो भव चैवं भवाम्यहम् ।। ७.१९.१० ॥
transliteration: dīyate dvandvayuddhaṁ te rākṣasādhipate mayā ।santiṣṭha kṣipramāyatto bhava caivaṁ bhavāmyaham ।। 7.19.10 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of that evil-minded Ravana, Anaranya, the lord of Ayodhya, became greatly enraged and then spoke to the lord of Rakshasas.
